title: Non Performing Assets and Rehabilitation of Industrial Undertakings Legal Proceedings Amendment Act 2004

sections.shortTitle: Non Performing Assets and Rehabilitation of Industrial Undertakings Legal Proceedings Amendment Act 2004
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 2004
ACT IV OF 2004
NON‑PERFORMING
ASSETS AND REHABILITATION OF INDUSTRIAL UNDERTAKINGS (LEGAL PROCEEDINGS)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act to amend the
Non performing Assets and Rehabilitation of Industrial Undertakings (Legal
Proceedings) Ordinance, 2000.
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 6th September, 2004]
No. F.22(16)/2004‑Legis.,
dated 4‑9‑2004.‑‑‑The following Act of Majlis‑e‑Shoora
(Parliament) received‑ the assent of the President on the 31st August,
2004, and is hereby published for general information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Non‑performing Assets and Rehabilitation of Industrial Undertakings
(Legal Proceedings) Ordinance, 2000 (LVIII of 2000) for the purpose hereinafter
appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.--‑(1) This Act may be called the Non‑performing
Assets and Rehabilitation of Industrial Undertakings (Legal Proceedings)
(Amendment)' Act, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
